metadata.title: Leadership Summary
metadata.description: Weekly executive briefing for Pre-Sales leadership

bluf.bottomLine:
Kicked off $6M+ MUFG Demo AI Endpoint Build (Credit Assessment)
• Successful CBK Coast demo review with LoB
• Request to deprioritize E6 demo asset access due to TSYS acquisition
• Demo Asset and Visibility (Banking NA) High Priority
• Coast MSA Renewal still Pending with Finance (Robert Rossetti)
• Executive Summary Platform final testing in progress ready for launch
bluf.background:
MUFG Credit Assessment strategic deal requiring Azure OpenAI endpoint deployment
• Demo Asset and Visibility initiative driven by need for status view across Banking NA demo systems
• TSYS acquisition driving International Issuing Hub strategy realignment
• Executive Summary platform completing final testing phase
• 2026 goals and initiatives drafted, awaiting RevOps review
bluf.assessment:
**1. Strategic Progress:**
• Executive Summary platform within final testing phase

**2. Cross-Team Collaboration:**
• Open Sessions approved with Sales Growth Office
• TSYS demo alignment clarified available assets

**3. Critical Risks:**

bluf.recommendation:
Complete Executive Summary Platform testing and launch
• Escalate Coast MSA renewal to CFO if Finance delays persist
• Proceed with Demo Asset and Visibility initiative rollout
• Finalize 2026 goals with RevOps for publication
